Drop scones

Ingredients

  • 175g/6oz self-raising flour
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • ¼ tsp salt
  • 1 tbsp golden caster sugar
  • 150ml/5fl oz milk
  • 1 medium egg
  • 1 tbsp melted butter, plus extra for greasing

To serve

  • jam, to serve
  • clotted cream

Method

  1. Mix the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in a bowl and make a well in the middle.

  2. Beat the milk, egg and butter together, pour into the well and whisk to a thick batter.

  3. Heat a greased griddle over a medium heat and drop on tablespoons of batter.

  4. Turn when bubbles appear on top and cook until golden underneath. Keep warm in a tea towel.

  5. Serve with jam and clotted cream.
